stage0070_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Look, I don't want to say this, but
　sitting next to that gloomy face of yours
　is ruining a perfectly good drink...」

stage0070_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I can pretty much guess what's on your mind.
　You're just too naive, $$アンナロッタ$$-chan.」

stage0070_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Do you know what kodoku is?」

stage0070_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Being idle like this every day...
　gives me plenty of time to pick up odd knowledge...」

stage0070_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Kodoku, you see, is a curse.
　You throw poisonous bugs in a jar, let them
　kill each other, then use whichever one survives.」

stage0070_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「A bug that survived hell itself...
　Bound to spread one hell of a curse, I bet.」

stage0070_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「This planet really is fascinating.
　We'd never think of something like that on Geminai.」

stage0070_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Don't tell me you're...!」

stage0070_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now then... I wonder who'll survive to the end...」

stage0070_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Are you angry now?
　Then let me tell you the cure for your heart.」

stage0070_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Just cut off whatever's frustrating you.
　Without a trace, that is.」

stage0070_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Do that, and whatever's troubling you
　will vanish completely, clean and simple.」

stage0070_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Is that why you hide in drink, because you can't?」

stage0070_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's an unfair way to put it.
　I drink because I like it, that's all.」

stage0070_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Oh, take care if you're heading out.
　If something happened to you, the Geminaid would...」

stage0070_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I don't need you to tell me that...!」

stage0070_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You're just too serious, $$アンナロッタ$$-chan...」

stage0070_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You should understand by now.
　Pride won't fill your stomach,
　and memories won't fill your heart...」

stage0070_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah.
　Might be since first term, at this rate.」

stage0070_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But I'm glad,
　getting to see everyone in class again.」

stage0070_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$詩織$$
「Come to think of it, where's $$ＭＩＸ$$?」

stage0070_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アンディ$$
「...He's still out there working.
　They're short on hands over there too.」

stage0070_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$風間$$
「Is the Volunteer Club really that busy?」

stage0070_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$甲児$$
「Guess so.
　We work worldwide, after all.」

stage0070_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$n
「It's not just beach cleanup, you know.
　Trash around the colony mirrors,
　in war zones abroad, at tourist spots...」

stage0070_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「It's all just trash pickup either way!」

stage0070_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　The Volunteer Club's work started
　as trash duty for Class 2-4, after all.」

stage0070_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$恭子$$
「So Kana abusing her power as class rep
　ended up cleaning the whole world, huh.」

stage0070_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$恵理$$
「It's a bit late in the term, but
　I'll introduce a transfer student today.
　...Come on in.」

stage0070_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$恵理$$
「What is it, Sagara?
　Shouting out of nowhere like that.」

stage0070_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$宗介$$
「N-No...
　I got worried whether I'd put the fish
　from my friend in Hokuriku in the fridge...!」

stage0070_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh, right!
　The sea bream, from Sado, that...」

stage0070_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$恵理$$
「Please, in front of the transfer student,
　try not to do anything too strange.
　Now, Ms. Testarossa... your introduction, please.」

stage0070_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$.
　Please, call me $$テッサ$$.」

stage0070_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$風間$$
「Transfer girls are always beauties...
　That jinx holds strong once again!」

stage0070_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$カレン$$
（I don't know either.
　I just got back to Earth yesterday...）

stage0070_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$宗介$$
「Sensei...!
　This is sudden, but I must go to the restroom!」

stage0070_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$恵理$$
「Class is about to start, so hurry.」

stage0070_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$かなめ$$
「N-Now, about $$宗介$$'s sandlot baseball team,
　he's aiming his batting toward third base...!
　I mean, against the third baseman, so...」

stage0070_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$恵理$$
「I thought the basics of batting was hitting it back at the pitcher...」

stage0070_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$!
　Hurry up and get to the bathroom already!」

stage0070_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...This looks like a fun class.」

stage0070_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$恵理$$
「Y-Yes...
　I suppose you could see it that way.」

stage0070_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$恵理$$
「Ms. Testarossa is here on a one-week exchange.
　Everyone, please make her feel welcome.」

stage0070_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$宗介$$
「Danaan, come in...!
　This is $$ウルズ$$ 7, Sergeant $$相良宗介$$!」

stage0070_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
???
「Sneaking out during morning HR isn't very admirable.」

stage0070_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Is this the school life that gave me an ulcer
　to win back for you? How sloppy indeed.」

stage0070_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$宗介$$
「L-Lt. Colonel...!
　Why are you at Jindai High!?」

stage0070_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「As you well know.
　It's for the Captain's study-visit paperwork.」

stage0070_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「The Captain has taken this week as leave.
　She said she wants to watch you, her subordinate,
　and Miss Chidori up close during that time.」

stage0070_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Don't get conceited, Sergeant.
　Conversely, this could also be read as doubt
　in your ability to perform your duty.」

stage0070_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Honestly... why would the Captain pick a man like this...」

stage0070_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Never mind, forget it.」

stage0070_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Listen well, Sergeant.
　This week, you will work with the other $c
　members and serve as the Captain's escort.」

stage0070_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「If any danger comes to her during this leave,
　or she suffers any manner of hardship,
　I intend to take resolute action.」

stage0070_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Do you understand what that means?」

stage0070_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Very well.
　And if someone, taking advantage of her time off,
　committed some indecent act on the Captain...!」

stage0070_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「I'll stuff you into a torpedo tube
　and fire you out with 300 kilos of explosives!
　By God and Her Majesty, I'll tear you apart!」

stage0070_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$宗介$$
「N-Not at all, sir!
　I would never...!」

stage0070_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Do you understand, or not!?
　Yes, or no!?」

stage0070_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$テッサ$$
「So this is the Volunteer Club's clubroom!
　I finally got to see it with my own eyes!」

stage0070_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$テッサ$$
「What's the matter, everyone?
　Is school life really this exhausting?」

stage0070_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$かなめ$$
「There's no 'what's wrong' about it!
　We're all worn out from babysitting you all day!」

stage0070_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$カレン$$
「During the cross-country run in P.E.,
　you went running off the wrong way, all alone...」

stage0070_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$クラン$$
「During the lunch bread scramble at the store,
　you bravely charged the front line, got crushed
　in the crowd, and nearly didn't make it out.」

stage0070_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Even I didn't expect that, admittedly.」

stage0070_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$n
「It can't be helped.
　Captain Testarossa just doesn't really
　understand Japanese school life yet.」

stage0070_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ルカ$$
「No surprise, coming from the original transfer student.」

stage0070_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$n
「No... it's nothing worth thanking me for...」

stage0070_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$n
「Wh-what was that, all of a sudden...!?」

stage0070_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$宗介$$
「I won't allow indecent behavior
　toward the Colonel...!」

stage0070_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$テッサ$$
（D-did you hear that, $$カレン$$...!?
　Sagara's become my knight...!
　Or is it jealousy toward $l!）

stage0070_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Put that gun away, $$宗介$$!
　Been back one day and already causing trouble!?」

stage0070_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$サザンカ$$
（Is it my turn to be jealous now!?）

stage0070_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Did you say something, $$サザンカ$$?」

stage0070_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「N-no...!
　I didn't say a thing, yes ma'am!」

stage0070_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Now, now, $$かなめ$$.
　My leave is only a week long.
　Let's enjoy it while it lasts.」

stage0070_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...True.
　It's $$テッサ$$'s vacation, and she's always busy.
　I'll give it my all to welcome her.」

stage0070_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$アルト$$
（This is going to go on for a whole week...）

stage0070_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...It's been about a week since Captain
　Testarossa transferred into Jindai High...」

stage0070_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Seems like she's getting through school life okay.」

stage0070_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$シン$$
「Don't act so laid-back about it...!
　Try getting nightly phone calls full of
　complaints from $$アルト$$ and $$カイエン$$!」

stage0070_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「For the record, I get calls too,
　taking turns between $n and $$ルカ$$ griping.」

stage0070_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ファ$$
「Mine come from $$さやか$$ and $$カレン$$.」

stage0070_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「From what I heard, over this one week,
　Jindai High's property damage topped 10,000G...」

stage0070_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That includes injuries from $$竜馬$$'s
　angry punishments too, or so I hear.」

stage0070_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Can't really call this peaceful school life...」

stage0070_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「To think this is that $c...」

stage0070_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Earth and the colonies are at war,
　and mankind's end is closing in, yet
　here they are, going on about school...」

stage0070_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$シン$$
「Did you want to go too?」

stage0070_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop it, $$ギュネイ$$.
　As you well know, over this past week,
　we've kept up our duties as $c too.」

stage0070_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Amid all that, it's not a bad thing
　for each of us to value everyday life.」

stage0070_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$タケル$$
「Especially since Captain Testarossa's
　leave is time-limited. Cut her some slack.」

stage0070_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Are you considering your own position?」

stage0070_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Please don't worry.
　Her Excellency $$ハマーン$$ has no intention
　of bringing you back for now.」

stage0070_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$オードリー$$
「So I'm not needed, then...」

stage0070_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's not something I can say.」

stage0070_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Anyway, that leave ends this weekend.
　Captain Testarossa returns to duty soon.」

stage0070_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$シン$$
「The volunteer club's having a farewell
　party, all going to $$くろがね屋$$ together.」

stage0070_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$くろがね屋$$...
　the hot spring inn run by $$甲児$$'s mom, right?」

stage0070_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yeah...
　$c's members have dropped by there
　more than a few times too.」

stage0070_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$タケル$$
「Good timing.
　Let's tag along too.」

stage0070_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ファ$$
「Right.
　That place can handle it even if
　all of $c goes together.」

stage0070_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But it seems $$ヒイロ$$'s group has a mission.」

stage0070_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Yeah...
　Executive Officer $$マデューカス$$ from the Danaan
　gathered $$ヒイロ$$'s group earlier.」

stage0070_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I know, $$明神タケル$$.
　That's your precognition, isn't it!」

stage0070_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$タケル$$
「No, that's not it...
　This is a hunch born of experience.」

stage0070_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$テッサ$$
「How lovely!
　What a classical-style hot spring inn!」

stage0070_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$安$$
「As for the missus, she's out on business.」

stage0070_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$お菊$$
「No need to worry, young master.
　We're keeping $$くろがね屋$$ running just fine.」

stage0070_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「Besides, we've got great part-timers too.」

stage0070_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ボス$$...! And $$ヌケ$$ and $$ムチャ$$ too!」

stage0070_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$さやか$$
「You guys... when you didn't show at school,
　I figured you'd be at $$くろがね屋$$.」

stage0070_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ボス$$
「Yeah.
　We're working students, you know.」

stage0070_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$安$$
「Impressively, these guys came to us
　asking to work at $$くろがね屋$$ themselves.」

stage0070_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ヌケ$$
「We figured we should earn at least
　our own living expenses ourselves.」

stage0070_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「That's the story, so today
　we'll welcome everyone from $c
　as staff.」

stage0070_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Good work, good work!
　Counting on you guys!」

stage0070_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Well then... shall we hop into the hot spring?」

stage0070_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$カレン$$
「Agreed!
　$$テッサ$$'s worked hard this past week too.」

stage0070_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Let's soak away our fatigue in the hot spring.」

stage0070_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Okay, us girls will hit the bath first.」

stage0070_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$マオ$$
「Don't get any stupid ideas about peeping, $$クルツ$$.」

stage0070_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That's the boss for you...
　Sharp as ever.」

stage0070_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$宗介$$
「I see...
　I'm going for a walk.」

stage0070_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$クルツ$$
「$n...
　I need a favor, counting on your field skills.」

stage0070_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Come with me for a march drill in the mountains.」

stage0070_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$n
「...So basically, I take the shortest route
　down this mountain to the target point?」

stage0070_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That's right.
　I need you at the front of the march.」

stage0070_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$n
「The members are $$クルツ$$, $$ボス$$, $$ヌケ$$, $$ムチャ$$...
　Kind of a weird lineup, if you ask me...」

stage0070_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ボス$$
（Hey, $$クルツ$$...
　wasn't it a bad idea to bring $n in?）

stage0070_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ヌケ$$
（That's right.
　He hasn't realized this is peeping on
　the girls' bath. If it's found out, we're dead.）

stage0070_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ムチャ$$
（That guy... he's weirdly serious.
　Mess up and he'll pound us with $$ブーストアップ$$.）

stage0070_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ボス$$
（Sure, going down the mountain trail's risky,
　but we can handle it on our own.）

stage0070_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$クルツ$$
（No... my gut's sensing danger here.
　We need his help on this one.）

stage0070_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$クルツ$$
（If it's found out, it's found out.
　I can think up excuses all day.）

stage0070_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$クルツ$$
（I want to repay the effort you two put in,
　scouting the site ahead of time and picking
　the route for this whole plan.）

stage0070_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ムチャ$$
（Going that far for us bit players...）

stage0070_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Lead or side character, doesn't matter.
　We're a team.）

stage0070_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ボス$$
（Alright...!
　If you'll say that much, we're all in too!）

stage0070_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$n
「...I'll say this now.
　My way's rough.」

stage0070_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Yeah, might've picked the wrong guy after all...）

stage0070_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$アルト$$
「...Yeah, hot springs really are great.」

stage0070_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I never thought it'd feel this good.」

stage0070_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$甲児$$
「Right?
　Even my grandpa raved about
　the water at $$くろがね屋$$.」

stage0070_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$安$$
「Now then, gents.
　Let me scrub those backs, one after another.」

stage0070_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$シロー$$
「Take it easy and rest up today, you guys.
　Sensei's cooking up a storm too.」

stage0070_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$カイエン$$
「That sounded like an explosion...」

stage0070_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$甲児$$
「This is just a hot spring inn.
　Nobody's gonna go and do something like that.」

stage0070_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ヌケ$$
「B-Boss! When did this whole area
　turn into a minefield!?」

stage0070_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ボス$$
「How the hell would I know!!」

stage0070_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Tch!
　My bad feeling about this just came true!）

stage0070_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Most likely, that $$宗介$$ punk got told
　by old man $$マデューカス$$ to go and
　guard the women's bath, I bet!）

stage0070_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$n
「$$クルツ$$!
　So this is why you asked me along!」

stage0070_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$クルツ$$
「O, oh...!
　If it was just a drill, I wouldn't have invited you!」

stage0070_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$n
「Traps at this level...
　Either $$宗介$$ or $$ヒイロ$$ set these...!」

stage0070_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$クルツ$$
「There's bound to be more traps up ahead!
　Break through them, and we win!」

stage0070_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$n
「Bring it on!
　I won't lose at field tactics and traps!」

stage0070_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$デュオ$$
「But how about facing us instead?」

stage0070_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$カトル$$
「I'm disappointed in you, $n.
　To think even you'd join a scheme like this.」

stage0070_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ would be sad, if she knew.」

stage0070_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$五飛$$
「Enough talk!
　I'll beat that rotten spirit out of you!」

stage0070_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$n
「I'm not soft enough to just say 'yes sir'
　after being told off one-sidedly like that.」

stage0070_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Heh, seems like out here in the mountains
　the $$ビーストハンター$$ blood's caught fire.」

stage0070_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$n
「I'll handle things here with $$ボス$$ and the others!
　$$クルツ$$, you break through!」

stage0070_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Code, $$プリベンター$$ 5... executing the mission.」

stage0070_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ヌケ$$
（B-Boss... some peeping's turned into a real mess...）

stage0070_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ボス$$
（Screw it, we're going for broke!
　We're in this too!!）

stage0070_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$n
「All five of them are first-rate agents...
　We broke through, but they forced our route
　way off from the planned spot...」

stage0070_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$n
「D-don't worry about it...
　It's just something between friends...」

stage0070_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
???
「Did you get in a fight or something...?」

stage0070_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$n
（What a striking person...
　Wonder if they're a guest here...）

stage0070_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
???
「This hot spring... it's a nice place...」

stage0070_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
???
「Here, I feel like I could forget every bad thing...」

stage0070_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$n
「...Is there really something that bad going on?」

stage0070_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$n
「Sorry...
　Acting like I understand your situation.」

stage0070_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
???
「...Won't you let me see your face more?」

stage0070_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Fine, whatever.
　We've already surrounded this inn.」

stage0070_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$n
「《$$ファイヤバグ$$》, is that it...!」

stage0070_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Huh... so you knew about us.」

stage0070_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
Firebug Trooper
「But it's too late now, no matter what you do!
　Our Project Princess
　will be completed, right here!!」

stage0070_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Sorry, $n, $$ボス$$, $$ヌケ$$, $$ムチャ$$...
　Your sacrifice won't be wasted...!）

stage0070_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Almost there...!
　Almost at the women's bath's outer wall!）

stage0070_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$クルツ$$
（The ultimate sight I'm about to see...!
　I swear I'll describe it to you all, in words!）

stage0070_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$クルツ$$
「I-I found you... is that what you're getting at...」

stage0070_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$クルツ$$
「W-wait, $$宗介$$!
　We can talk this out...!」

stage0070_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Y-you idiot!
　Don't go pulling out a bazooka in a place like this!!」

stage0070_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's sounded noisy outside for a while now...」

stage0070_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$いぶき$$
「It's fine.
　$$クロス$$ said the security for that
　sort of thing was airtight.」

stage0070_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Well then, that's a relief.」

stage0070_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That child's adorable, isn't she, Colonel Katsuragi?」

stage0070_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「This is $$ペンペン$$, the hot-spring penguin.
　I brought him along, since it was a good chance.」

stage0070_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$葵$$
「What is going on here!!
　The wall just blew off!!」

stage0070_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$くらら$$
「An enemy attack, in the women's bath!?」

stage0070_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$カレン$$
「This isn't the time for that, $$さやか$$!!」

stage0070_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$アルト$$
「A-anyway!
　Let's get out! Something's definitely happening!」

stage0070_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Now, now, kittens!
　Dipping your towel in the bath breaks the rules!!」

stage0070_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「From here on, I'll be running this show:
　$$ゲイツ$$, formerly Amalgam, now of $$ファイヤバグ$$!!」

stage0070_03:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Nuoooh!!
　I didn't know they had a bodyguard like this!!」

stage0070_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Forced mixed bathing, a pervert, and $$ボン太くん#pilot$$...
　Now that's chaos.」

stage0070_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't be so stiff about it.
　It's the $$くろがね屋$$, after all.」

stage0070_03:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「$$竜馬$$'s right.
　The fight against Geminis is about
　to reach its final stage anyway.」

stage0070_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$弁慶$$
「This might be our last drink ever.
　Let's savor every bit of it.」

stage0070_03:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$お菊$$
「I'll keep bringing out the food, so
　drink up and enjoy yourselves.」

stage0070_03:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$安$$
「This banquet over, $$くろがね屋$$ closes for a while.
　So we'll go all out serving you!」

stage0070_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$安$$
「We haven't heard from the proprietress either.
　We can't keep this up much longer.」

stage0070_03:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$クロス$$
「Knowing her, she's probably
　out there doing something we don't know about.」

stage0070_03:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「Then we'll just have to do our part too.」

stage0070_03:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$安$$
「Once things are peaceful again, the proprietress
　will come back and $$くろがね屋$$ reopens.」

stage0070_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$ローレライ$$
「$$シロー$$ and I will hold the fort till you're back.」

stage0070_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$お菊$$
「Count on you, $$ローレライ$$.
　See that the young master goes to school, too.」

stage0070_03:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$クロス$$
「That's how it is, $$ボス$$.
　We'll back up your Borot.」

stage0070_03:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$安$$
「Starting tomorrow, we'll help you out.
　So for today, you help us instead.」

stage0070_03:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$ヌケ$$
（$$ボス$$...
　what even were we, this time around...）

stage0070_03:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$ムチャ$$
（Worked to the bone at $$くろがね屋$$,
　beaten black and blue by $$ヒイロ$$ and the others,
　and we still can't reach paradise...）

stage0070_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ボス$$
（Shut up!
　I want to cry too!）

stage0070_03:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Thank you, $$かなめ$$, Sagara...
　and everyone else too...」

stage0070_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I'll... never forget this past week.」

stage0070_03:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$カレン$$
「What pisses me off is the $$ファイヤバグ$$ crowd.
　Because they broke the wall, we...」

stage0070_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It was an unfortunate accident.
　Let's forget it.」

stage0070_03:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$ファ$$
「$$カミーユ$$...
　you sound like it's not your problem...!」

stage0070_03:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Now, now, $$ファ$$!
　Atami's fine, so let's just
　enjoy ourselves!」

stage0070_03:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Thank you, Weber.
　For lightening the mood.」

stage0070_03:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Nah, nah... something like this
　is a piece of cake for $$クルツ・ウェーバー$$.」

stage0070_03:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What's wrong, $$宗介$$?
　You don't like crab?」

stage0070_03:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$宗介$$
「Not a problem.
　Don't worry about it.」

stage0070_03:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Act more natural, $$宗介$$.
　Or everyone will find out $$ボン太くん#robot$$
　smashed through the women's bath wall.）

stage0070_03:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Don't worry.
　I don't plan on telling anyone the truth.
　But in exchange, you get it, right?）

stage0070_03:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$宗介$$
（So I'm to stay silent to Lt. Colonel $$マデューカス$$
　about your peeping... Very well.）

stage0070_03:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Alright, deal's done.
　Maybe I could be a negotiator!）

stage0070_03:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
$$カトル$$
（$$クルツ$$... I don't want to condone
　such underhanded behavior.）

stage0070_03:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$トロワ$$
（And dragging $n into it besides
　will leave Miss $$スズネ$$ thinking the worst.）

stage0070_03:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$五飛$$
（If you feel any remorse, judge yourself now.）

stage0070_03:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$クルツ$$
（F-forgive me...!
　I'll never do it again...!）

stage0070_03:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$カトル$$
（...Very well.
　Thanks to $$ボン太くん#robot$$, it never went past an attempt.）

stage0070_03:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（But don't forget, $$クルツ・ウェーバー$$...
　you owe me one for this.）

stage0070_03:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$かなめ$$
「C'mon, c'mon, $$ヒイロ$$, you too!
　Don't make that sour face,
　let's all sing karaoke together!」

stage0070_03:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What do you say?
　How about a duet, just you and me, $$宗介$$?」

stage0070_03:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$マオ$$
「Add $n, $$刹那$$, and $$キリコ$$ to that,
　and how about the Silent Five doing a mood song!?」

stage0070_03:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh! Miss $$スズネ$$'s getting quite
　tipsy herself!」

stage0070_03:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I can't get through this without a drink!
　Especially not this past week!」

stage0070_03:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Now sing, Silent Five!
　The forbidden song!」

stage0070_03:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You're surprisingly into it, $$刹那$$.」

stage0070_03:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Hey, everyone! Listen up!
　The Silent Five's singing, $$刹那$$ up front!!」

stage0070_03:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Alright!
　Leave the backup to us...!」

stage0070_03:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I hope days like these keep going on forever...」

stage0070_03:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I'll... do my best.
　To protect this world.」

stage0070_03:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$マキ$$
「...Not good.
　The usual fear's started coming on and off.」

stage0070_03:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$n
（Might be from the effects of the $$エタニティ・フラット$$...）

stage0070_03:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$n
「...I'm managing to hold it back, somehow.」

stage0070_03:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$n
（Strange...
　Maybe... it's because $$アドヴェント$$
　touched me back then...）

stage0070_03:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$マキ$$
「Sounds like you're pushing yourself again.」

stage0070_03:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$マキ$$
「Could it be that's the reason
　you came to see me?」

stage0070_03:r_cc01b694a39de719.text:
$$マキ$$
「Thank you.
　I'm glad you'd rely on me.」

stage0070_03:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$マキ$$
「My shift's almost over for today,
　so how about we get something to eat?」

stage0070_03:r_64f86b30363f1f4c.text:
$n
（$$マキ$$, $$シンヤ$$, $$ミサコ$$...
　I'll protect you all, and this world too...）

stage0070_03:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$n
（$$アンナロッタ$$... and $$ガドライト$$...
　don't think I'll let you have your way...）

stage0070_03:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... So it was you, Master $$宗介$$.」

stage0070_03:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$宗介$$
「The field test's complete.
　This one's finished too, more or less.」

stage0070_03:r_6d287e4652a3781f.text:
$$宗介$$
「As a compact, city-type AS, of course.
　Eventually I'll mass produce it and
　sell it to the military or police.」

stage0070_03:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$宗介$$
「If possible, I'd also like to reference the
　RVF-25's system for slaved drone linkage.」

stage0070_03:r_1c42d2bca3a5e3a3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For that, you'll need more practical data.」

stage0070_03:r_b23f4e273f76c5a8.text:
$$宗介$$
「Not a problem.
　From now on, $c will operate this thing.」

stage0070_03:r_2488b984097a7bdf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's wonderful!
　With $$ボン太くん#robot$$ joining up,
　the ladies will surely be thrilled!」

stage0070_03:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even from $$ボン太くん#robot$$'s efforts today,
　we earned 100 Z Chips.
　I've added them to the squad's stock.」

stage0070_03:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$宗介$$
「...But I do have concerns.
　No matter who I tell, $$クルツ$$, $$マオ$$,
　$$甲児$$, or $n, none of them agree.」

stage0070_03:r_131bea3d5d957e98.text:
$$宗介$$
「I simply can't understand what they mean
　by unnatural, strange, or bizarre.」

stage0070_03:r_fc994d6aae0712cc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's only natural.
　Master $$宗介$$ hasn't actually seen
　$$ボン太くん#robot$$ charging around the battlefield.」

stage0070_03:r_18ef8ab6be368d72.text:
$$宗介$$
「Do you think it's strange too?」

stage0070_03:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No...
　As long as it's fun, it's all OK, right?」

stage0070_03:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'll take your advice.
　Now then...」

stage0070_03:r_e5f4d0fca11502fa.text:
$$安$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$.
　We've heard about you from $$ボス$$ and the others.」

stage0070_03:r_f3ed55718d2364ba.text:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「We're the Kurogane Five.
　We'll be in your care from now on.」

stage0070_03:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$クロス$$
「You and us, we're both freeloaders in this squad.
　Let's be brothers on equal footing.」

stage0070_03:r_82218191e135e576.text:
$$お菊$$
「No need to be so nervous.
　We're not about to eat you or anything.」

stage0070_03:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$クロス$$
「Listen up, boys!
　We'll do our part as newcomers too!」

stage0070_03:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「Well then... let's get fired up today, too...」

stage0070_03:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
$$お菊$$
「We'll give you plenty of service～!」

stage0070_03:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Sigh... Doesn't look like we'll get customers today...）
